entries.german: Ruprecht gebietet allen seinen unterthanen in Bayern für seinen vetter Meinhard von Tirol, den befehlen Conrads von Rosenberg vitztums zu Amberg oder in dessen verhinderung dem landschreiber gehorsam zu sein. Karlsr. Coph. 463,61 (durchstrichen).
entries.english: Ruprecht commands all his subjects in Bavaria on behalf of his cousin Meinhard of Tyrol, to be obedient to the commands of Conrad von Rosenberg, Viztame at Amberg, or in case of his absence, to the regional scribe.
facts: Konrad von Rosenberg is titled Vitzthum zu Amberg
Konrad von Rosenberg held administrative authority over Bavarian subjects
Ruprecht commanded his Bavarian subjects to obey Konrad von Rosenberg's orders
